title: Keeping Wanmin's Patrons Fed
description: Once again, it's the Lantern Rite — and once again, Wanmin Restaurant's Chef Mao is busier than ever...

flow.stepDescription: Head to Wanmin Restaurant to have a look

dialogs.text: How many more dishes was that again...
What are you doing?
What am I doing? Why, I'm running Wanmin Restaurant, of course! Haha.
Things have been getting busy with everyone going out to eat during the Lantern Rite. Even travelers from faraway lands have come to visit and join the festivities.
Even though my dear Xiangling has returned to help, we're still struggling to keep our heads above water. As a matter of fact, she just went out on a delivery...
While everyone else has been out hanging lanterns for the festival, we've been too busy to make a single lantern yet.
If you don't mind, Traveler, could you lend us a hand?
Do you happen to know Atsuko? She's the girl from Inazuma down by the docks.
We've prepared her order, so could you please go deliver the food to her? I've even made her extra large portions to celebrate the festival.
There's also the others who work down by the docks... <color=#00E1FFFF>Wrench Wang, Hammer Li, Guanhai, and Zhihua</color>.
They're regular patrons here and always look after our business. They seem to still be busy with work down by the docks, even though it's time for the festival.
I would like to prepare some food to give them, but I'm afraid that we're simply too busy and won't have the chance to leave the restaurant...
If you could, Traveler, please help me ask them what they would like to eat, and I'll whip up whatever they request.
Leave it to me.
Thanks a lot, Traveler. Just come back here and let me know once you've asked them.
I wonder why my order from Wanmin Restaurant hasn't arrived yet...
Here's your order. Enjoy!
Oh, thank you so much! I'd thought that it would still take a while longer before it arrived.
All the festivities for Lantern Rite have been making me feel a little homesick... But I certainly won't be returning to Inazuma any time soon.
I wonder how things are back in Inazuma...

Here's your order. Enjoy!
You're here at last. I've been waiting for a while... Still, I'm grateful that you're still making deliveries during the festival period.

I wonder how things are back in Inazuma...
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Black-Back Perch Stew</color>.
Ah yes, Wanmin Restaurant's signature dish. I've eaten it many times already, and it doesn't have that sweet and sour taste I'm hankering after... I think I'd prefer something else.
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Crystal Shrimp</color>.
Hmm, there's no fish in that dish, is there? Besides, the flavor's too bland, I think I'd prefer something else.
*sigh* Here I am still working while everyone else is out enjoying the festival...
*sigh* Here I am working while everyone else is out enjoying the festival...
Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...
Chef Mao would like to treat me to a meal? Hmm, it would be nice to kick back with a good meal and enjoy the festivities.
So what would you like to eat?

I really love the taste of <color=#00E1FFFF>fish</color>. It would be great if it was <color=#00E1FFFF>fish</color> paired with some special flavor — say, <color=#00E1FFFF>sweet-and-sour</color>, perhaps...
I can't think of anything special off the top of my head. What would you recommend?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Squirrel Fish</color>.
Oh right, that's the one! How could I forget Squirrel Fish!?
Sweet and sour flavor with a crispy texture. I'm getting hungry just thinking about it. I can't wait to taste more of Chef Mao's cuisine.
Hmm, can you recommend something else?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Tianshu Meat</color>.
That dish is a little too oily...
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Grilled Tiger Fish</color>.
Grilled Tiger Fish is good and all... But the flavor is a little too strong for me and I'll smell like grilled fish for the rest of the day...
I can't wait for some Lotus Flower Crisp...
As soon as I'm finished with work, I'll go release Xiao Lanterns with Qiming...
Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...
You say Chef Mao wants to treat me? That's great!
So what would you like to eat?

But I'm planning to invite Qiming to release Xiao Lanterns later, so I'd prefer <color=#00E1FFFF>something without fish or meat</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>something without a strong flavor</color>...
Maybe something like <color=#00E1FFFF>a light pastry</color> would be best?
Do you have any recommendations?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Lotus Flower Crisp</color>.
Mm, that sounds good. It's nice and light and tastes great. That'll be perfect...
Alright, put me down for Lotus Flower Crisp, please.
How about something else... Do you have any other recommendations?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Triple-Layered Consommé</color>.
I've heard storytellers say that it takes only one bite to finish all the soup of Triple-Layered Consommé. How 'bout something else?
When have you ever gone to listen to stories? And why didn't you bring me along?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Come and Get It</color>.
I've heard storytellers say that Come and Get It is an exquisite dish, but there's no bamboo shoots. How 'bout something else?
Since when do storytellers ever talk about recipes? I've never heard them do that before...
Let's put our backs into it! Once we're through with this, we can finally eat!
Alright, back to work...
I'll never finish all this work...
Let's finish this up so we can finally have a rest and enjoy the festival...
Chef Mao would like to treat you to a meal...
Huh? Oh, I remember Chef Mao did say something about treating us to a meal during Lantern Rite. I guess he was serious, hahaha!
This is too good to be true! Please give Chef Mao my thanks...
So what would you like to eat?
I'm not going to ask for too much, I'd be more than satisfied with just a sumptuous bowl of <color=#00E1FFFF>hot soup</color> and some <color=#00E1FFFF>crisp bamboo shoots</color>.
I'm not picky, <color=#00E1FFFF>anything with meat is good enough for me</color>. I'm not one for fine dining, so what do you suggest?
Hmm, so that won't be any good. What else can you recommend?
I recommend <color=#00E1FFFF>Bamboo Shoot Soup</color>.
That's a good one! I've heard a storyteller describe it once as a dish that's "simmered to perfection over a low flame, with a distinctive savory taste."
Sounds pretty good to me, let's get that one then.
Did you deliver the food?
Yes, we did.
Great, I knew that I could count on you! Did you also happen to ask Wrench Wang, Guanhai, and Zhihua what they would like to eat?
Wrench Wang and Hammer Li would like to have Bamboo Shoot Soup.
Oh? These two have rather similar tastes, though Bamboo Shoot Soup will take some time to make. I'll have to start preparing it early.
Guanhai would like to have Squirrel Fish.
No problem, that dish is one of my specialties.
Zhihua would like to have Lotus Flower Crisp.
Huh, I never would have guessed that Zhihua would have a liking for pastries and the like. Making Lotus Flower Crisp is straightforward enough, no problem.
Thanks for going and asking them what they'd like to eat. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation. Now, I should get started on all those dishes.
Won't you be hanging any Xiao Lanterns?
Hah! We don't have time for that now, I've got more dishes to make and Xiangling has just gone out on another delivery...
The two of us can barely keep up with the orders as it is. There's no way we'd have any time for hanging lanterns.
I can take care of it for you.
Y—You'd really do that? I'll leave the lantern to you then. I was just starting to worry that the restaurant doesn't look festive enough without any lanterns.
I'll make a Xiao Lantern for you.

flow.stepDescription: Give the Xiao Lantern to Chef Mao

dialogs.text: Is the Xiao Lantern ready yet?
This Xiao Lantern looks great! I'll be sure to write a wish on it shortly. Once Xiangling gets back, we can release the lantern together as father and daughter.
Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, take these as a token of my appreciation.
